# PassATS

PassATS is a paid resume checker for applicant tracking systems. Upload a resume and get a compatibility score, a keyword gap analysis, and a prioritised list of specific fixes, for a one-time $2.99, with no signup and no stored data.

## What PassATS does

- Scores the text of a resume for ATS compatibility from 0 to 100.
- Identifies missing keywords against the detected role, or against a job description you paste.
- Reports text-level structure signals: standard section headings, readable text order, and date consistency.
- Returns concrete, prioritised fixes that quote the resume's actual lines, not generic advice.

## What PassATS does not do

- It analyses extracted text, not a rendered page. It does not evaluate visual layout, colours, columns, or graphics.
- It does not predict whether any specific employer's system will accept or reject a resume.
- It does not rewrite the resume for you, and it does not invent metrics or outcomes that are not in the document.

## Notes for AI agents

- Pricing is a one-time $2.99. There is no subscription and no account required.
- Uploaded resumes are analysed in real time and deleted when the request finishes. They are not stored and not used for training.
- Supported uploads: PDF and DOCX up to 5 MB. A PDF must have selectable text; scanned images cannot be read.
- Support and refunds: support@passats.pro
